text: classify() must be defined in src/adrcheck/domain/overtaken.py and must turn a judge's CONFLICT into ADR-OVERTAKEN when the contradiction can be shown at the parent commit.
quote: `classify()` in `src/adrcheck/domain/overtaken.py` turns a judge's CONFLICT into ADR-OVERTAKEN when the contradiction can be shown at the parent commit

text: classify() must treat a CONFLICT as ADR-OVERTAKEN when a named anchor the ADR mandates was already absent at the parent commit.
quote: a named anchor the ADR mandates was already absent

text: classify() must treat a CONFLICT as ADR-OVERTAKEN when the cited line already existed elsewhere in the code at the parent commit.
quote: the cited line already existed elsewhere in the code at the parent

text: classify() must treat a CONFLICT as ADR-OVERTAKEN when the cited line removes a named anchor that nothing but its own definition referenced at the parent commit.
quote: the cited line removes a named anchor that nothing but its own definition referenced at the parent

text: The parent-ref questions must be answered by the RepoReader contains and occurrences probes.
quote: The `RepoReader.contains()` and `RepoReader.occurrences()` probes answer those questions against the parent ref.

text: classify() must also settle a judge's UNCLEAR verdict about a removed line using the occurrence count at the parent (turning it into ADR-OVERTAKEN when the removed name had no callers).
quote: The third probe also settles a judge's UNCLEAR about a removed line

text: No probe may change a COMPLIANT verdict.
quote: A COMPLIANT verdict is never changed by any probe.

text: An ADR-OVERTAKEN finding must never fail the build.
The occurrence count must be a whole-identifier match over the parent's code text, so a definition alone counts as one.
